headline: Break slides to blown-out Santa Rosa; triangle runs warm both days
body:
Safety first. The east channel (PZZ650) goes under a small-craft advisory from 3 PM today through evening, W 15–25 kt building this afternoon, seas 2–4 ft; Sunday settles to S 5–10 then W 10–15, seas 2–3 ft — the better day inside. Do not run west: the outer waters past Santa Rosa (PZZ673) hold an advisory through late Monday, NW 20–25 kt and 6–8 ft both days.

The problem is water, not weather. Triangle corners all read warm — west 72.1, east 71.9, south point 70.2 today, barely cooler tomorrow (71.8/71.8/69.9). The 64–68 break is not inside the triangle; the cool side has slid off onto Santa Rosa Flats, 67.9 today, 67.7 tomorrow — and that ground is unfishable in the advisory.

So neither day puts you on the break in safe seas. If you go, make it Sunday and work the triangle's south point — the coolest corner, nearest the break — but expect to be fishing off it. Osborn and San Nic run warm too; no run pays.
